_about: Parts of one Blender model that stand up through ANOTHER model's roof, hidden in the built tiles by scripts/v2/clip_tiles.mjs (pipeline stage 5, run after build_tiles.mjs: `node scripts/v2/clip_tiles.mjs`). The Blender builds themselves are not touched. Found by scripts/verify/v2-tile-pokes.mjs (it prints a clip entry for every poke it finds). clips[]: slug = the model the part belongs to, over = the model whose roof it crosses, tile = the tile file (lod0 only: the far mass has none of these), seed = a corner of the part, box = [x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1] world metres round it (the check's bounding box); the triangles of `slug` inside the box that are joined to the seed corner are dropped, tris = how many triangles that is (the stage refuses to run if the box now holds a different number: the model changed, look again), why = what the part is. A clip with a uv field [u, v] (the palette coordinate of one colour) drops EVERY triangle of slug in the box that is painted that colour, joined to a seed or not (for a ground sheet that came out in several pieces); seed is then unused. known[]: pokes the check lists but nobody has decided on (a hidden part would leave a hole; the owner or the next builder decides); the check fails on any poke that is in neither list.

clips.why: DKR's guessed entry-pavilion canopy: a 34 m x 11 m slab sloping from 12.4 m down to 10.2 m. Over Moncrief-Neuhaus's hall roof (12.0-12.4 m) its upper face stands 0.3-0.5 m above the roof and drew as a tan patch on the red roof (aerials, 2026-10-24). Nothing of it is a photographed part of either building; the slab is inside Moncrief's volume where the roof is.

DKR's site-terrain grass: the stadium build's own scan-derived ground sheet (material site_grass, palette colour 59,66,50), a ring round the east and south of the bowl whose outline follows the scan's raster cells, so it drew as green stair-stepped patches on the app's ground (live since 10-25). It is ground, not part of the building: the app draws the ground. 728 triangles in five pieces, all painted the one palette colour; the turf, the paving and every other part keep their triangles.

known.why: Icon's podium roof (19.9 m) stands up to 1.1 m above Villas on Nueces's roof where the two models overlap by about 40 m x 30 m. v2/tiles/inventory.md already flags icon (tower parts up to 86 m outside its outline: a possible offset). Hiding the podium roof would leave a hole; the placement of Icon is the question, not the roof.
